entities.name: Phlage
entities.description: Titan of Burning Wind and Fire's Fury, an all-consuming whirlwind of fire imprisoned in the Underworld.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: God of fate who volunteered as jailer of the titans in the Underworld.

entities.name: Titans
entities.description: Primal urges made flesh sealed away by the gods.

entities.name: Gods of Theros
entities.description: Gods who sprang from mortal devotion and sealed the titans away.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm where the titans are sealed.

events.summary: Mortals pray, giving rise to the gods, who seal the titans away in the Underworld.
events.quote: From this concentrated devotion sprang forth the gods themselves.

events.summary: Klothys volunteers as jailer, sequestering herself in the Underworld as an eternal seal.
events.quote: Klothys , the god of fate, volunteered as their jailer

relations.note: Klothys imprisons Phlage in the Underworld.
relations.quote: imprisoned in the Underworld by Klothys

relations.note: Phlage is one of the Titans.
relations.quote: Phlage is one of the Titans of Theros
